# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

No additional code changes were required in this Apply Fixes pass. The latest review approved the root-zone oxygenation implementation and subsequent cleanup amendments, including the unused shrimp reproduction wrapper removal, with no blocking follow-up requested.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspect the latest approved review results to confirm whether any blocking amendments were requested for the implemented fixes.
2. [Skipped] Apply additional code changes for review follow-up items.
3. [Completed] Record the approved validation state from the latest package test, clippy, formatting, and targeted regression runs.

## Validation Evidence

- Latest review outcome was `approved` with no blocking amendments required.
- `cargo test -p tank_core` passed across the full `tank_core` package test suite with zero failures.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_core -- -D warnings` passed.
- Formatting check was clean in the latest review validation.
- Review also reconfirmed passing substrate/root-zone oxygenation, denitrification, save/load, and reproduction-factor coverage.

## Outstanding Risks

- This stage relied on the latest approved `tank_core` validation results rather than rerunning a fresh workspace-wide test suite.
- Two non-blocking cleanup opportunities remain from review: initialization-time `from_parts` still discards the returned `SubstrateOxygenationBreakdown`, and `root_oxygenation_active_biomass_g()` still recomputes the habitat registry internally.
